'''2000 Bespin Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Bespin region (Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00bespin">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=bespin 2000 Regionals: Bespin], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726145848/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=bespin Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Nick Reisch]] of Watertown, South Dakota won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 29 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Best Western Central Omaha, Nebraska
* '''Players:''' 81<ref name="tr-d1058" />
